[EN] We need to keep the pressure on the argons.

Take the field and kill kalash devastators, zariik spodas, manaathol executors, athakela prowlers, and zomgul gatherers.

Report to Sheris at Shroud Outpost when you're done.
[ES] Tenemos que mantener la presión sobre los argons.

Sal al campo y mata a los kalash devastators, zariik spodas, manaathol executors, athakela prowlers y zomgul gatherers.

Preséntate ante Sheris en Shroud Outpost cuando termines.

[EN] Outstanding effort.

Keep up your good work!
[ES] Esfuerzo sobresaliente.

¡Sigue con el buen trabajo!

[EN] It doesn't look like you've completed your mission.
[ES] No parece que hayas completado tu misión.
